title: Utility Services Program Schedule of Account Fees and Flat Monthly Charges
content:
# Schedule of Account Fees and Flat Monthly Charges — Utility Services Program

Amounts are in US dollars. A flat monthly charge of $0.00 means the program does not bill that charge separately; a billing administration fee of $0.00 means the program has none.

## Account fees

| Program | Monthly billing administration fee | One-time account setup fee at activation | Setup fee waived on the account opened for an in-community transfer |
|---|---|---|---|
| Essentials Utility Plan | $3.95 | $25.00 | Yes |
| Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan | $3.95 | $25.00 | Yes |
| Submetered Water Plan | $4.95 | $35.00 | Yes |
| Submetered Water & Gas Plan | $4.95 | $35.00 | Yes |
| Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan | $5.95 | $45.00 | Yes |
| All-Inclusive Utility Package | $0.00 | $45.00 | Yes |

## Flat monthly service charges

| Program | Trash | Pest control | Stormwater drainage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Essentials Utility Plan | $18.00 | $4.00 | $3.50 |
| Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan | $18.00 | $4.00 | $3.50 |
| Submetered Water Plan | $18.00 | $4.00 | $3.50 |
| Submetered Water & Gas Plan | $18.00 | $4.00 | $3.50 |
| Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan | $18.00 | $4.00 | $3.50 |
| All-Inclusive Utility Package | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |

## Notes on the schedule

- The setup fee is a one-time fee of the account's program at activation; the waiver column states, for every program, that the fee is waived on the account opened for an in-community transfer.
- On the All-Inclusive Utility Package the billing administration fee and the three flat service charges are all $0.00.

*Illustration (hypothetical account):* an account on the Submetered Water & Gas Plan that is not opened for an in-community transfer carries a setup fee of $35.00; a full month on that program carries a billing administration fee of $4.95 and flat charges of $18.00 for trash, $4.00 for pest control and $3.50 for stormwater.
